reasoning_traces.think:
The IMPLEMENT NOW QUEUE enforces a hierarchical lattice of resource dispositions using a binary classification system: approved-direct and prototype. This structure is constrained by a rights gate mechanism that filters out quarantined or owner-reviewed resources. The operational safety of each resource is determined by its category, which is classified into six types—dev_tool, ai_ml_cost, testing_qa, design_ux, content_intel, and data_ops—each with an associated vetting status. These primitives form a dual lattice: one of dispositions and another of safety levels. The enforcement mechanism ensures that only resources passing through the findGatedLeaks filter can enter the queue. This creates a robust Bayesian inference model in GSI where each resource's probability of being safe depends on its category and vetting history. In GSE, these primitives drive state transitions through deterministic telemetry feedback loops, ensuring that only validated resources proceed to operational use. Failure modes occur when the gate fails to reject invalid resources or when categorization misclassifies a resource’s safety level.
